body: The speeding ticket's dated after they shut down access. I see pencil marks changing the time. The beer bottle's still sealed, dropped at the gate.
title: Speeding ticket, beer bottle and pencil

body:
Keep the infield closed until the pesticide trial dries. The first heat remains on the board, so the groundskeeper has to refund a child's ticket from his own coffee jar.

The trial crew sprayed the grass at dawn and the infield still smelled sweet at noon. Our copy stayed on the kitchen table.

When I returned, the window was closed and the board was blank. I kept the page because it was the only one with our address.
title: Memo
